name: Reported State-directed education and assignment pipeline

attribution.legal_posture: Official UN human-rights reporting preserves the report's 'reportedly' language and cited-source limitations; individual student or graduate findings require source-specific evidence.

caveats: Education, technical skill, age, language, nationality, location, and student status are unsuitable as DPRK-attribution or screening shortcuts.
The report cites external research for parts of the pipeline and repeatedly uses reported language; student progression into an IT-worker or cyber-operator function requires source-specific evidence.

statements: A/80/149 reports a State-directed pathway in which some pupils selected for mathematics and science ability proceed through specialized secondary schools and top-university programming or specialist training.
The report says candidates are reportedly recruited into the Korean People's Army and assigned to the Reconnaissance General Bureau, or hired by information-technology organizations and companies.
The report also says that, since 2021, the National Science and Technology Committee has managed a categorized pool of science-and-technology specialists.

sources.support: Supports the reported school-to-university training pathway, subsequent assignment to military/intelligence or IT organizations, and the reported science-and-technology specialist-pool management role
